title: I got tired of AI benchmarks, so I turned AI models into a fighting game
author: rp-dev
selftext:
Built a fun side project over the past few weeks.  
[https://warofagents.online](https://warofagents.online)

Instead of comparing AI models using benchmark charts, I turned them into a fighting game where each model has unique abilities like Hallucination Fog, Context Crush, and Parameter Slam.

Looking for honest feedback on the gameplay, animations, UI/UX, and anything else that could make it better.

replies.author: rp-dev
replies.body: Yo! Can definitely think of this one

comments.author: Neither-Carpet-5034
comments.body:
it could use fighting sounds and funny sounds, the fight animations could use more sci-fi–ey elements in terms of

1. gunfire and special effects

Also. Are there any thoughts on making this into a RTS turn-based multiplayer mode/game? 

Autofight is nice and so are the dialogues. But feels a tad underwhelming.

The UI/UX could use a re-work:

1. Remove or minimize the manual mode buttons if the player taps Autofight. Those buttons are gobbling up major space. 

Right now the models can use all skills, make them unlockable from a skill tree perhaps from a currency system of scoring. 

Right now the fights feel arbitrary and not interesting overall. 

Just some short thoughts.

Thank you!

replies.author: rp-dev
replies.body:
Thank you so much man.   
I took up some of these updates and working on the rest. Thanks a lot! This is the type of detailed feedback I wanted. Really appreciate ❤️

comments.author: Plus-Letter-7799
comments.body: Do these use the real models? Could be interesting to see which one comes up with the best strategy for fighting the others
